import pandas as pd

# Read source CSV files with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length4_88/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length4_88/training_1.csv", index_col=0)
source2 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length4_88/training_2.csv", index_col=0)
source3 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length4_88/training_3.csv", index_col=0)

# Extract only the 'TrackID' column from each source
source0_trackid = source0[['TrackID']]
source1_trackid = source1[['TrackID']]
source2_trackid = source2[['TrackID']]
source3_trackid = source3[['TrackID']]

# Concatenate (UNION) all TrackID columns from the four sources
union_df = pd.concat([source0_trackid, source1_trackid, source2_trackid, source3_trackid], ignore_index=True)

# Remove duplicates to match the target key uniqueness
union_df = union_df.drop_duplicates().reset_index(drop=True)

# Ensure TrackID column is integer type as per target schema
union_df['TrackID'] = union_df['TrackID'].astype(int)

# Write the final target table to the specified CSV path without the index
union_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_88/target_multisource.csv", index=False)
